# Lines stripped from MARLEY output before the "golden file" comparison used
# to detect unexpected physics changes in CI.
#
# The golden file's cache key includes a hash of this file, so editing it
# invalidates the cached golden file and will cause a new one to be generated.
#
# Required usage:
#
#   grep -v -f <(grep -v -e '^#' -e '^$' .github/golden-filters.txt) FILE
#
# Stripping comments and blank lines first is not cosmetic: grep -f treats an
# empty pattern as matching every line, so passing this file directly would
# filter both files down to nothing and the diff would pass vacuously.
#
# Each non-comment, non-whitespace line below is a regular expression.

# Run timestamp.
^T MARLEY

# HepMC3 library version
^HepMC::Version

# Parsed job configuration
^A MARLEY.JSONconfig
